 Tribal leader Nisha Bhagat ends life on camera in Ranchi
 By News Desk 
 Friday, 6 November 2026, 16:09:08 IST 
 0 
 Facebook WhatsApp X Telegram 
 Prominent Jharkhand tribal rights activist Nisha Bhagat died on Friday after attempting suicide during a Facebook Live broadcast.
 Relatives rushed Bhagat to the Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences in Ranchi, where doctors declared her dead upon arrival.
 Before taking the extreme step, the Pithoria resident started a Facebook livestream that quickly went viral across social media.
 During the emotional broadcast, Bhagat spoke extensively about her prolonged battle against alleged local land mafias and administrative failures.
 She claimed certain individuals ran deliberate smear campaigns to defame her, while authorities failed to act against the perpetrators.
 Available reports indicate Bhagat spoke directly with the officer-in-charge of the Pithoria police station shortly before starting her livestream.
 In the video, she stated that she had fought alone for too long and felt completely abandoned by peers.
 Bhagat also expressed deep sorrow regarding the immense grief her sudden death would inevitably bring upon her grieving parents.
 She voiced sharp anger over critics calling her a middleman, noting officials ignored her repeated complaints regarding character assassination.
 Bhagat further alleged that members of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh and Bharatiya Janata Party failed to support her cause.
 Highlighting ongoing struggles surrounding tribal identity and the Sarna faith, she lamented the personal toll of her relentless activism.
 Investigators have not yet independently verified the serious allegations Bhagat raised during her final broadcast or her exact motives.
 Across Jharkhand, people widely recognized Bhagat for her vocal advocacy of indigenous rights and official Sarna religion recognition.
 Last year, she captured widespread public attention when she shaved her head during a major Sarna religious rights protest.
 Bhagat also entered electoral politics, contesting the 2024 Jharkhand Assembly elections as a candidate from the Gumla constituency.
 Her sudden demise has sparked widespread shock and grief across tribal social groups and regional political circles in Jharkhand.
 Community leaders and supporters now demand accountability regarding the serious systemic issues she highlighted during her final social media video.
 Local police officials have registered a case and launched a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding her tragic death.
